quote: POWERCHINA signed a business contract for the San Carlos Photovoltaic Power Station project in Argentina on March 26. The San Carlos Photovoltaic Power Station project will be located in Salta Province in northern Argentina. POWERCHINA will be responsible for the design, procurement of equipment and materials, construction, installation, and commissioning of an 18.3-megawatt photovoltaic power station.
note: Opened POWERCHINA San Carlos Salta EPC primary (18.3 MW; CapEx blank).
